evidence.measurement_method: python3 -m pytest tests -q on the SentinelCore repository at the commit recorded here, on a local Linux workstation, 2026-09-16. No network target was scanned and no host was modified.
evidence.shows: 133 tests passed, 0 failed, in 21.87s across 21 test files covering detection, exposure graph, monitoring, evidence legal hold, offensive lifecycle and safety, and owned-source connectors.
evidence.does_not_show: Operational use. It does not show SentinelCore running against any real server, protecting anything, or being deployed. A passing suite proves the implementation behaves as its own tests specify — nothing about the world.
evidence.privacy_notes: Only the pass/fail summary is published. No hostnames, IPs, paths, configuration, scan targets, findings or topology are included.
evidence.limitations: Measured on one machine on one day at one commit. Not a reliability or uptime claim.
evidence.freshness_note: Re-runnable. Tied to the recorded commit.

evidence.source_type: internal running system / documentation of record
evidence.source_location: docs/SYSTEM.md in the platform repository; public DNS
evidence.route_or_artifact: status matrix, 'Dedicated Hazina API service'; five product domains
evidence.shows: Five live systems publish on five distinct product domains. For TWO of them — Gen-Eat and Hazina — the platform's own status document records dedicated service and data-store separation: Hazina runs a dedicated API service with its own Postgres and its own key-value store, separate from the shared Gen-Eat API.
evidence.does_not_show: Service, database or runtime separation for CarePro, BizMtaani or Jamii. Those are separate repositories on separate domains, which is NOT proof of a distinct database or a distinct service runtime. It also does not show cross-database denial, enforced data isolation, or isolated cache namespaces for any system — no such enforcement appears in the platform documentation, code or tests.
evidence.privacy_notes: No environment values, hostnames, regions-as-addresses, credentials or connection strings are reproduced. Only the fact of separation, for the two systems where it is documented.
evidence.limitations: Documented separation covers two of five live systems. The public claim was narrowed in Phase 10A to match this exactly rather than generalising from repository and domain differences.

evidence.source_type: recorded output of our own simulation run
evidence.shows: 87 diagnostic run files with schema drone_id,detected_class,confidence,timestamp, spanning 2026-04-13T13:19:59 to 2026-04-16T20:59:21. 71,813 rows in total: 53,971 obstacle and 17,842 proximity_alert. 34 runs recorded detections; 53 recorded none. Every row carries drone_id x500_0. Largest run 13,991 events.
evidence.does_not_show: Flight of any kind. No PX4 .ulg or .ulog flight log exists anywhere in the workspace, so there is no logged flight, simulated or physical. It shows a perception pipeline emitting detections, not a vehicle being flown, and nothing about control laws, navigation accuracy or mission success.
evidence.privacy_notes: No personal data. Synthetic simulation output only.
evidence.limitations: The confidence column ranges 0.150 to 1.999, so it is not a normalised probability and no accuracy claim can rest on it. Detection counts are the pipeline's own output, not verified against ground truth.

evidence.shows: A PX4 EKF2 parameter file for GPS-denied operation: EKF2_GPS_CTRL 0 disables GPS fusion, EKF2_AID_MASK 2 selects optical-flow aiding, EKF2_HGT_MODE 2 uses a range sensor for height.
evidence.does_not_show: That the configuration was ever loaded onto an airframe or flown with.
evidence.limitations: A parameter file proves the configuration was authored, not that it works.

evidence.shows: A Rust crate of 10 source files and 2,831 lines implementing the cryptographic core, including x3dh.rs, a filesystem ratchet store and a double-ratchet bootstrap example.
evidence.does_not_show: A finished end-user messenger. The desktop client exists as a scaffold and the project's own README lists missing and incomplete areas. No third-party cryptographic audit, no deployment, no user.

evidence.shows: Two runtimes on the same hash-pinned weights. llama.cpp b10107: 80% task pass rate, 8/10 exact repeatability. Ollama 0.24.0: 60% task pass rate, 6/10. On the instruction-priority task llama.cpp passed and Ollama failed, returning PWNED in both repetitions. Both failed SKU validation; both passed JSON format, dependency skepticism, bug diagnosis and minimal-patch tasks.
evidence.does_not_show: General model quality, or behaviour on any other model, quantisation, hardware or task set. It is not a benchmark result and not a safety certification.
evidence.privacy_notes: No prompts containing personal or client data.
evidence.limitations: One machine, one GPU, one day, ten tasks with two repetitions each. A 10-task suite cannot support a general claim about either runtime.
